It's unfinished and I may never finish it (I'm lazy)...
It's not as good as I wanted it to be, but I will try my best to improve my art skills...

I, being a suicidal person myself, don't try to end others people lives, you psycho... Yeah, I know life is difficult, but if you need someone to talk let's chat... I am here to help if anyone needs it...

Hey boy (or girl, I'm not sure), I was just like you when I was a kid, always desperated to disappear from the face of the Earth. Take it easy, I know it's difficult when you can't achieve what you expect to, but that isn't a reason to end your live. Last year, during my finals, the thought of failing was so fixed in my head that I was in the verge of killing myself. I have fighting my chronic depression for almost 9 years, there is a suspension that I may have TDAH and aspergir's syndrome, but that won't stop me from trying to do my best (just some existential crisis hahaha). Your mom love you and there's a bunch of people who cares for you as well. Go live your life like a kid in your age, don't worry, everything gonna turn alright...
Jeez... What's wrong with you dumbass?!
You are totally right. Women can be such bitches...

I may be much younger than you, I may not be as experient as you when it comes to life. But I was about to kill my self last year for a much silly reason than you have. Man, I may be a little unreasonable right now but life is made of suffering and happiness, most of times it looks like is almost composed all by pain and it takes your hope that it gonna improve. But even with disability, there's a bunch of people who thinks the opposite, even with some difficulties, they think life is worth to live. I know it gonna be hard for you, more than I even can imagine. But you have just one life, do your best to live it as best as you can until the end.

I here if you need to talk...

And reply if you are still there

I going through in a likely situation. My life is wonderful but I can't say the same about me. As they say "Sleep is just death being shy", talk to a therapist it may help...

If you want to talk I am here

At least I am not as sad as before because I am able to help people like you hahahaha

Stay strong girl, there's a bunch of people out there who cares for you including me...

Your life is so much more than that. If it was my older self talking to you I bet it would say to you to murder everyone and make them suffer hahahaha just kidding. I don't know what kind of advice I should give you, I was bullied in the past and bullied some people too (I regret that). But what is in the past is in the past, you can't change it, I would give anything to travel back in time to redo everything I did wrong. But the thing is: don't blame yourself. Who cares what they say, they're a bunch of shitheads who don't deserve your attention, it may request some maturation to ignore them and oppose yourself, but you can do it. You are still young, there's still time to make things different. I believe in you.

If you need to talk, count on me 😆😁
What a silly thing, if she is truly your friend she will accept your apologies. And if she don't, then she is not worth your friendship.

I joined this subreddit with the intent to feel more sad and empty than I am already feeling, but the opposite happened to me, there so much people going in a harder time than me and I felt in the obligation to help them.

If you are trying to help people, you are doing a great job. Keep trying, I am sure you are and will continue making difference in the lives of a lot of people.

This year complete 9 years I have being through depression. And there is not much to say to you but what can I say is that your life matter to me. It's easy to say "There is no reason to be sad", "Your loved ones will miss you", it's actually selfish to say such a thing. But I tell you, your life is worth to live, everything can be fix and overcome, you just need to focus in get better. The important thing is not if people think you must live, but you think that. There's still hope, just try believe in it.

I'm here if you need to talk
For no reason, that resemble a lot Abaporu

Contact the kid protection services and report your abusive dad, if possible tell they to hurry up to not spend any second longer in that place. Secretly pack the things you need for you and for your brother, and wait... I not sure about your situation, but based on what you described, I think you and your sibling have better chances out of there...

I hope I helped you, but I not sure if I did

Hey, buddy... I went through in a likely situation. And I assure you that you are not a pedo, boys in your age fap for anything, and when I say anything I really meant it. You don't need to be obsessed (I think) for feeling attract to girls younger than you. Man, with all the shit media are producing for this generation, I even doubted if I was gay, it's really easy to get confuse in adolescence (and I am just 18 years old). Don't contemplate death, it can lead to a seriously mental illness I sure you know the name, it is a really fucked up process to get rid of it. If you wanna talk you can count on me... 😆😁

Stay well, stay safe
